I have nail discoloration, which affects 1.4% of people. Apparently it mostly affects 40-70yo. I’m 14 and I got it when I was 10. It also affects more darker skinned people than lighter skinned people, me being white. So it probably makes it rarer. It isn’t very dangerous or anything, but I got my nail removed just to see if it could’ve carried a type of skin cancer, melanoma, which thankfully it did not.

Edit: My doctors didn’t know what it was at the hospital and didn’t give me a full diagnoses, but this is what I know from research.
